name: Reye-like Syndrome due to Fatty Acid Oxidation Defects
aliases: Fatty Acid Oxidation Defect-associated Reye-like Syndrome
Mitochondrial Fatty Acid Oxidation Disorder with Reye-like Presentation

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Proposed Diagnostic Criteria for Reye-like Syndrome due to Fatty Acid Oxidation Defects

criteria.description: Acute non-inflammatory encephalopathy with altered consciousness
Evidence of acute liver failure with elevated transaminases and coagulopathy
Biochemical or genetic confirmation of mitochondrial fatty acid oxidation defect
Exclusion of viral infections commonly associated with Reye syndrome
Presence of fasting hypoglycemia or hypoketotic hypoglycemia

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of acute encephalopathy and hepatic dysfunction plus biochemical or genetic confirmation of fatty acid oxidation defect
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires exclusion of classical Reye syndrome causes and other metabolic disorders.

pathognomonic.notes: Rapid onset altered mental status without evidence of infection
Marked elevation of liver enzymes and impaired synthetic function
searchTerms: sudden liver failure with bleeding risk
acute liver disease with clotting problems

occasional.notes: Reduced muscle tone during acute phase
Elevated blood ammonia contributing to encephalopathy
Occasional cardiac involvement in severe cases

rare.notes: Muscle breakdown with elevated creatine kinase

imaging: Brain MRI may show cerebral edema
Liver ultrasound typically normal or enlarged
genetic: Mutations in genes encoding mitochondrial fatty acid oxidation enzymes (e.g., ACADVL, CPT2, HADHA)
other: Abnormal acylcarnitine profile on tandem mass spectrometry
Reduced fatty acid oxidation enzyme activity in fibroblasts or liver biopsy

distinguishingFeatures: Absence of fatty acid oxidation defects
Marked hyperammonemia without significant liver enzyme elevation
Genetic mutations in urea cycle enzymes

references: Roe CR, et al. Fatty acid oxidation defects presenting as Reye-like syndrome. J Pediatr. 2002.
Spiekerkoetter U, et al. Diagnosis and management of fatty acid oxidation disorders. Mol Genet Metab. 2010.
Wilcken B. Fatty acid oxidation disorders: clinical features and diagnosis. J Inherit Metab Dis. 2003.
